name: easy-xtream-football-tizen
description: Easy Xtream Football for Samsung TV (Tizen)

scripts.build:store: npm run strings && EXF_SAMPLE_LIST=false node build.mjs
scripts.build:store:tizen: npm run strings && EXF_SAMPLE_LIST=false EXF_COFFEE=false node build.mjs --platform=tizen && ~/tizen-studio/tools/ide/bin/tizen package -t wgt -s nezor -o "$PWD/dist" -- "$PWD/dist/tizen" && cp "dist/Easy Xtream Football.wgt" dist/exf-store-1.0.0.wgt
scripts.build:store:webos: npm run strings && EXF_SAMPLE_LIST=false node build.mjs --platform=webos && ares-package dist/webos -o dist && EXF_SAMPLE_LIST=false node build.mjs --platform=webos --res=720 && ares-package dist/webos720 -o dist/720
